classification.difficultyReason: Apply exact acute-angle ratios and quadrant signs to find three ratios for each angle.

content.prompt: Find the exact value of the sine, cosine and tangent function of:

answer.worked:
The related angle is $180^\circ-150^\circ=30^\circ$. In quadrant II, sine is positive; cosine and tangent are negative.
$$\begin{align*}\sin150^\circ&=\sin30^\circ=\frac12\\\cos150^\circ&=-\cos30^\circ=-\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\\\tan150^\circ&=-\tan30^\circ=-\frac1{\sqrt3}\end{align*}$$

The related angle is $180^\circ-120^\circ=60^\circ$. In quadrant II, sine is positive; cosine and tangent are negative.
$$\begin{align*}\sin120^\circ&=\sin60^\circ=\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\\\cos120^\circ&=-\cos60^\circ=-\frac12\\\tan120^\circ&=-\tan60^\circ=-\sqrt3\end{align*}$$

The related angle is $180^\circ-135^\circ=45^\circ$. In quadrant II, sine is positive; cosine and tangent are negative.
$$\begin{align*}\sin135^\circ&=\sin45^\circ=\frac1{\sqrt2}\\\cos135^\circ&=-\cos45^\circ=-\frac1{\sqrt2}\\\tan135^\circ&=-\tan45^\circ=-1\end{align*}$$

The related angle is $360^\circ-300^\circ=60^\circ$. In quadrant IV, cosine is positive; sine and tangent are negative.
$$\begin{align*}\sin300^\circ&=-\sin60^\circ=-\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\\\cos300^\circ&=\cos60^\circ=\frac12\\\tan300^\circ&=-\tan60^\circ=-\sqrt3\end{align*}$$

The related angle is $210^\circ-180^\circ=30^\circ$. In quadrant III, tangent is positive; sine and cosine are negative.
$$\begin{align*}\sin210^\circ&=-\sin30^\circ=-\frac12\\\cos210^\circ&=-\cos30^\circ=-\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\\\tan210^\circ&=\tan30^\circ=\frac1{\sqrt3}\end{align*}$$

The related angle is $360^\circ-330^\circ=30^\circ$. In quadrant IV, cosine is positive; sine and tangent are negative.
$$\begin{align*}\sin330^\circ&=-\sin30^\circ=-\frac12\\\cos330^\circ&=\cos30^\circ=\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\\\tan330^\circ&=-\tan30^\circ=-\frac1{\sqrt3}\end{align*}$$

The related angle is $240^\circ-180^\circ=60^\circ$. In quadrant III, tangent is positive; sine and cosine are negative.
$$\begin{align*}\sin240^\circ&=-\sin60^\circ=-\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\\\cos240^\circ&=-\cos60^\circ=-\frac12\\\tan240^\circ&=\tan60^\circ=\sqrt3\end{align*}$$

The related angle is $360^\circ-315^\circ=45^\circ$. In quadrant IV, cosine is positive; sine and tangent are negative.
$$\begin{align*}\sin315^\circ&=-\sin45^\circ=-\frac1{\sqrt2}\\\cos315^\circ&=\cos45^\circ=\frac1{\sqrt2}\\\tan315^\circ&=-\tan45^\circ=-1\end{align*}$$
